newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS FLAT ON MARK, GAINS VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV ENDS FLAT ON MARK, GAINS VS DLR.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 994-995 per mark on Thursday, flat on the opening and Wednesday's close in light interbank volume, traders said.
* Spot lev/dollar at 1,865-1,870 close from 1,875-1,880 at the opening and 1,874-1,878 at Wednesday's close.
* The lev has been pegged from July 1 at 1,000 per mark as an anchor in an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate regime aimed at restoring confidence in the lev.
* Under the system the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 levs bid and 1,000 ask.
